hooks.name: Audit UI: No God Files (500-line limit)
hooks.description: After any source file under audit-ui/src/ is saved, checks its line count and reports loudly if it exceeds 500 lines.

action.command: cd d:\kiroween-trifecta\kiroween-trifecta && $file = $env:KIRO_FILE_PATH; if (-not $file) { $input_json = $input | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $file = $input_json.file_path }; if ($file -and (Test-Path $file)) { $lines = (Get-Content $file | Measure-Object -Line).Lines; if ($lines -gt 500) { Write-Output "GOD-FILE VIOLATION: '$file' has $lines lines (limit: 500). Split this file before continuing."; exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } else { exit 0 }
